# 艾里森光电公开资料全本

> 艾里森光电（广东艾里森光电技术有限公司）围绕四类项目提供策划、设计、制作和工程配合：艺术装置、舞美装置、宫宴餐秀与城市更新。具体范围以现场资料、合同及书面报价为准。

最后更新：2026-11-15

## 公司做什么

AlisnART (Guangdong Alisn Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.) plans, designs, builds and supports four kinds of projects: art installations, stage installations, palace banquet shows and urban renewal. Each project covers lighting, structure, control and maintenance together, so a night-time scene can actually be built and keep running.

## 四条业务线

1. 艺术装置：景区入口地标、互动灯光装置、商业美陈、节庆美陈、酒店到达空间和公共艺术节点。
2. 舞美装置：湖面演艺、节庆舞台、移动巡游、水面自主装置和空地联动表演系统。
3. 宫宴餐秀：文化主题、餐序结构、空间舞美、灯光音响、演员动线和开业运营配合。
4. 城市更新：古镇滨水、商业街、公园广场、连续导视、公共艺术和模块化天幕系统。

## 项目如何启动

先把现场说清楚：选一个场景、规模、预算和开放日期，团队会准备一份可以直接发出的项目摘要。它不是报价，但能让第一次沟通更接近一个真实方案。联系：+86 18026422225 或 lansenlight@gmail.com。

有效的初步评估通常需要：场地位置、现状照片或视频、平面图与尺寸、游客动线、供电条件、预算范围、目标开放日期、使用周期和运营方式。效果图中的尺寸、材料、结构、设备和价格不能替代现场复核与书面技术文件。

## 报价、效果图与耐久性

- 预算和周期仅在明确场地、尺寸、材料、结构、运输、安装及审批条件后确认。
- 未明确标注为已完成项目的图片，作为概念或产品方向参考。
- 户外项目需按所在地环境复核结构荷载、电气防护、排水、散热、防雷、检修和消防条件。结构、防水、控制线路、检修口、运输分段和节目切换在设计阶段定好，不在现场临时定。
- 户外长期装置按所在地条件复核结构荷载、电气防护、排水、散热、防雷、检修和消防条件。

## 大型活动经验

The site lists lighting product or project collaboration related to the Hangzhou Asian Games, the Beijing Winter Olympics and the Guangzhou competition zone of the 15th National Games. The exact delivery scope is governed by project documentation; this is not a claim of official authorisation or exclusive-supplier status.

## 项目问答

### 艾里森光电是做什么的？

AlisnART (Guangdong Alisn Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.) plans, designs, builds and supports four kinds of projects: art installations, stage installations, palace banquet shows and urban renewal. Each project covers lighting, structure, control and maintenance together, so a night-time scene can actually be built and keep running.

### 四条业务线具体包括什么？

Art installations: scenic-entrance landmarks, interactive light installations, commercial and festive beautification, hotel arrival spaces and public-art nodes. Stage installations: lake performances, festive stages, mobile parades, water-based self-propelled installations and open-ground linked performance systems. Palace banquet shows: cultural themes, meal-sequence structure, spatial scenography, lighting and sound, performer routing and opening operations support. Urban renewal: ancient-town waterfronts, commercial streets, park squares, continuous wayfinding, public art and modular canopy systems.

### 公司在哪里，怎么联系？

The company is Guangdong Alisn Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd., based in Jiangmen, Guangdong, China (Factory 1, West Section, Nanshan Industrial Park, Dongsheng Road, Jianghai District). Project phone: +86 18026422225. International projects via WhatsApp: +86 15791503693. Email: lansenlight@gmail.com.

### 初步评估前需要准备什么？

A useful first assessment usually needs: site location, current photos or video, a plan with dimensions, visitor flow, power supply conditions, budget range, target opening date, usage period and operating model. Renders cannot replace an on-site review and written technical documents for dimensions, materials, structure, equipment or price.

### 网站上的效果图和预算是正式报价吗？

No. Budget and schedule are only confirmed once the site, dimensions, materials, structure, transport, installation and approval conditions are clear. Images not explicitly marked as completed projects are concept or product-direction references.

### 户外装置能长期使用吗？

Yes. Outdoor work is reviewed against local conditions for structural load, electrical protection, drainage, heat dissipation, lightning protection, maintenance access and fire safety. Structure, waterproofing, control circuits, inspection openings, transport sections and programme switching are fixed at design stage, not on site.

### 有哪些大型活动经验？

The site lists lighting product or project collaboration related to the Hangzhou Asian Games, the Beijing Winter Olympics and the Guangzhou competition zone of the 15th National Games. The exact delivery scope is governed by project documentation; this is not a claim of official authorisation or exclusive-supplier status.

### 项目怎么开始？

Start by describing the site: pick a scenario, scale, budget and opening date, and the team prepares a project summary that can be sent directly. It is not a quote, but it makes the first conversation closer to a real scheme. Contact: +86 18026422225 or lansenlight@gmail.com.
